title: Slash Command Not Found: Code Review Script Fails to Load
body:
**Bug Description**
Have a slash command (.claude/command/code-review.md) to do periodic code reviews.  Working well the last few weeks.  Now when called, Claude can not find.  

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.61
- Feedback ID: 

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error\n    at iU (/$bunfs/root/claude:487:1076)\n    at Y1 (/$bunfs/root/claude:488:9957)\n    at emit (node:events:92:22)\n    at endReadableNT (internal:streams/readable:862:50)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)\n    at request (/$bunfs/root/claude:490:2098)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2025-07-28T06:45:21.549Z"}]
```
